sources.own_factual_extraction: Regional cartography labels the Fortescue corridor separately from Ashburton and nearby coast-draining rivers, including its interior-to-coast orientation. The slopes text associates the flat Fortescue corridor north of the Hamersley Range with Fortescue Marsh.
limitations: The map raster is regional and low-resolution, with no coordinate grid sufficient for an exact reach crosswalk.
The assessment title year is 2012; the copyright publication year is 2013.
Two figures from one assessment are one publication, not independent evidence.
sources.publication_rights_note: Assessment copyright states 2013 and CC BY Australia 3.0 with exclusions. Figure-specific third-party rights were not separately resolved; no source map or report is distributed.

locators.title: Fortescue Marsh Nature Reserve: Plan area

sources.own_factual_extraction: The locality map names the broad Fortescue corridor. Hydrology distinguishes the lower river from the upper river and Marsh across Goodiadarrie Hills; transfer from the Marsh is expected only in extreme floods. Weeli Wolli, Coondiner and Mindi Mindi creeks are separately named inflows.
limitations: Generalized locality mapping does not prove ordinary through-flow, an exact marsh path or every source-reach name.
Only bibliographic and non-cultural hydrological facts are summarized; traditional knowledge, quotations, artwork and photographs are not reproduced.
sources.publication_rights_note: Copyright and Indigenous cultural/intellectual property notices on PDF page2 are retained privately. Public output contains only independently written factual findings, bibliographic locators and hashes; no full text, images or traditional knowledge.

independence: Three distinct official publications: national assessment, state hydrogeological study, and reserve management plan. Sources have separate purposes and dates; figures within each are not counted independently.
acquisition_stop: Bounded representative support and hydrological qualification established; source acquisition stopped.
